topic: Write a Website Article about "Learning by Doing"(写一篇关于"做中学"的网站短文)
title_en: The Art of Learning by Doing
genre: 网站短文 / 议论(general statement + personal experience as supporting details)
source: 上外版选择性必修第一册 Unit 1 Writing:write a short website article about "learning by doing"(先给出一个总观点,再用个人经历作为支撑细节)。
prompt_cn: 假设你叫李军,你为学校学生会的"做中学(Learning by Doing)"活动征稿。请用英语写一篇约100词的网站短文,内容包括:① 提出一个关于"做中学"的总观点;② 用你自己(或他人)的一段亲身经历作为支撑细节;③ 用一句话总结。注意:用上本单元时态(过去完成时/现在完成进行时/将来进行时),用个人经历让观点更有说服力。
prompt_en: Suppose you are Li Jun. You are calling for articles for your school's "Learning by Doing" event. Write a short website article (about 100 words) that: 1) gives a general statement about learning by doing; 2) uses your own (or someone else's) personal experience as supporting details; 3) ends with a concluding sentence. Try to use the unit's tenses (past perfect / present perfect continuous / future continuous).
points: 提出总观点(The idea of "learning by doing" is becoming increasingly appealing …)
用亲身经历作支撑细节(In the Art Club, I once …)
用单元时态(had done / have been doing / will be doing)
model_essay: The idea of "learning by doing" is becoming increasingly appealing to high school students, and my own experience shows why. Last term, I joined a three-dimensional design course in the Art Club. Before that course, I had always thought design was only about computers. To my surprise, we used our hands to fold paper into cranes, lanterns and towers. Each time a structure fell, I learned something new about balance. Since then, I have been telling my friends that we understand an idea best after we try it ourselves. Next month, I will be sharing these projects with our sister school in Singapore.
model_translation: "做中学"的理念正越来越吸引高中生,而我自己的经历就说明了原因。上学期,我在美术社参加了一门三维设计课。在那门课之前,我一直以为设计只和电脑有关。出乎意料的是,我们用双手把纸折成纸鹤、灯笼和高塔。每当一个结构倒下,我都对平衡有了新的认识。从那以后,我一直告诉朋友:只有亲手尝试,我们才能最透彻地理解一个想法。下个月,我将与新加坡的姊妹校分享这些作品。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:总观点 / 亲身经历支撑 / 总结句
先观点后例证、细节具体可信、行文连贯、总结呼应
句型词汇准确多样、单元时态(过去完成/现在完成进行/将来进行)运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 总观点 The idea of "learning by doing" is becoming increasingly appealing …
经历1 Before that course, I had always thought …（过去完成时)
经历2 Since then, I have been telling … （现在完成进行时)
展望/总结 Next month, I will be sharing … （将来进行时)
key_expressions: The idea of "learning by doing" is becoming increasingly appealing.
Before that course, I had always thought design was only about computers.
Since then, I have been telling my friends that …
We understand an idea best after we try it ourselves.

high_sentences: The idea of "learning by doing" is becoming increasingly appealing to high school students.
Before that course, I had always thought design was only about computers.
Each time a structure fell, I learned something new about balance.
We understand an idea best after we try it with our own hands.

error_pairs.wrong: Before the course, I have always thought design was easy.
error_pairs.correct: Before the course, I had always thought design was easy.
error_pairs.note: 过去某点之前的状态用过去完成时 had thought,不用现在完成时。

error_pairs.wrong: Since then, I tell my friends about it.
error_pairs.correct: Since then, I have been telling my friends about it.
error_pairs.note: since + 持续到现在的动作用现在完成进行时。

error_pairs.wrong: Next month, I share these projects with our sister school.
error_pairs.correct: Next month, I will be sharing these projects with our sister school.
error_pairs.note: 将来某时正在进行的动作用将来进行时。
